title: Soy salmon with asparagus
summary: Soy salmon with asparagus is a chinese dinner built around salmon fillets and asparagus, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat salmon fillets dry and season it. Prep asparagus and tamari for Soy salmon with asparagus so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook salmon fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook asparagus and tamari in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Soy salmon with asparagus before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice salmon fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
